notes: Choose your libraries: after adding a folder you tick which folders inside it are libraries, and only those are scanned (deeper folders, like a disc set's Disc 2, stay part of their show). Per library: English or German titles and which site to ask first (MyAnimeList, AniList, Kitsu, Wikidata). Folder names that aren't a MyAnimeList title are looked up on AniList and Kitsu; the same name there is a sure match, the rest waits under Library → Check matches.
